raw.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – SAP (m/f/d)
raw.description:
About Qorelo

Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a clean core, target-architecture-first approach and carry it end to end across SAP Activate, from Discover to Realize. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on.

We have raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.


The role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are Qorelo’s technical face at the customer. You run workshops and demos on the customer’s real SAP landscape, get Qorelo connected to their systems and tools, and make sure the platform delivers on their data and their processes. Then you bring what you learned back to our engineers.

You work directly with our engineering team and solution architects, report to Marino, our CTO, and spend a real share of your time with customers, both on site and remotely.

What you will own

  • SAP connectivity. RFC connections, technical users and authorisations. You make the connection work and explain it to Basis and security teams in their language.

  • Workshops and demos on real environments. You run on-site workshops of several hours and show Qorelo on the customer’s own SAP landscape, not a sandbox: their custom code, their processes, their data. You prepare together with sales and our solution architects, and you handle the technical questions in the room.

  • Integrations. You connect the customer’s tools to Qorelo through our existing integrations across the SAP, Atlassian, Microsoft and similar ecosystems, and make sure they work on the customer’s landscape.

  • The feedback loop. What you see at customers (where the product wins, where it falls short, what they asked for) comes back to engineering and product as clear, concrete feedback. You are the engineering team’s eyes and ears at the customer.

What you need

  • 5+ years in technical, customer-facing roles around SAP: technical SAP consultant, solutions or presales engineer, or an engineer who spent much of their time with customers.

  • Solid SAP technical understanding: you know how an SAP landscape fits together (ECC, S/4HANA), what RFC connections, technical users and authorisations are, and what a Basis team will ask you. You do not need to be an ABAP developer.

  • Enough technical depth to set up and troubleshoot a connection with the customer’s IT: credentials, firewalls, proxies, VPN, certificates.

  • Strong presence in the room: you can run a five-hour workshop with consultants, IT leads and process owners, demo live on their system, and keep it on track when something does not work.

  • Real AI curiosity: you use LLM tools yourself and can explain clearly what Qorelo does and where its limits are.

  • Willingness to travel within Europe for on-site demos and workshops.

  • Fluent English. German is a plus for our DACH client base.

 

You might be a fit if

  • You have been the person customers want in the room for the demo, and the one consultants call when the connection does not work.

  • You have worked at an SAP consultancy, system integrator or SAP software vendor and want to be closer to a product.

  • You enjoy a full day of workshops at a customer and can still explain clearly afterwards what worked, what did not and why.

  • You have taken software through an enterprise IT and security onboarding and know why it takes as long as it does.

What we offer

  • Real ownership. Meaningful equity and a direct hand in how Qorelo runs in the field. We are looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked for senior customer-facing technical talent in Berlin.

  • The problems. Fortune 500 and DAX 40 production landscapes, including Mercedes-Benz. You work at the core of SAP systems most engineers never get to touch.

  • The team. Short paths, fast decisions, and a direct line to our CTO, our founding engineer and our solution architects.

  • 25 days paid vacation + German public holidays.

  • Company offsites with the whole team.

  • An office at the Wasserturm in Prenzlauer Berg – where you work when you are not with customers. The fridge is stocked.

  • Wellhub membership, top-tier equipment and access to the latest AI tools.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call with Gaspar, our founding engineer (30 min)

  2. Deep dive on your SAP and customer-facing background with Marino, our CTO (60 min)

  3. Practical case: a workshop and live demo simulation with our engineers and solution architects

  4. Offer

How to apply

description: Als Account Executive (m/w/d) – Steuerkanzleien gewinnst du die Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region für Pennylane – vom ersten Gespräch über die Demo bis zur Unterschrift, häufig persönlich vor Ort in der Kanzlei. Du bist Owner des Umsatzes in deiner Region und machst Pennylane dort zur bevorzugten Plattform für Kanzleien und ihre Mandanten. In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du übernimmst das in Frankreich bewährte Playbook, entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Team für den deutschen Kanzleimarkt weiter und bringst zurück, was in deiner Region funktioniert. Du berichtest an den Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien in Berlin. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Hiring-Team, Case Study, Gespräch mit deinen künftigen AE-Kolleg:innen, Abschlussgespräch mit dem Head of Sales – alles remote, Feedback nach jeder Runde innerhalb von 48 Stunden. Standort München: Du arbeitest aus dem Homeoffice und bist in Kanzleien in Bayern und Baden-Württemberg unterwegs – München, Augsburg, Stuttgart. Etwa einmal im Monat kommt das deutsche Sales-Team für zwei Tage in Berlin zusammen. Zwei Account Executives verkaufen bereits in Deutschland an Steuerkanzleien, du kommst als Nächste:r dazu. Deine Aufgaben als Account Executive – Steuerkanzleien: Du baust deine Pipeline auf: Rund 50 % kommen aus deinem eigenen Outbound – Cold Outreach, LinkedIn, Empfehlungen, Branchenevents –, die andere Hälfte aus qualifizierten Inbound-Leads. Du bleibst dran, auch wenn die ersten Antworten ein Nein sind. Du führst beratende Discovery-Gespräche mit Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen, verstehst ihre Abläufe mit Mandanten und hinterfragst den Status quo. Du hältst deine Vertriebsziele konstant und baust den Marktanteil von Pennylane im Kanzleisegment deiner Region aus. Du denkst unternehmerisch, hast den Drive, einen neuen Markt aufzubauen, und übernimmst Ownership für deine Zahlen, dein CRM und deinen Prozess. Du hörst aktiv zu, trittst bescheiden auf und baust Vertrauen zu traditionell arbeitenden Kanzleien auf – auf Augenhöhe mit Partner:innen und Steuerberater:innen. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris – und du lebst in Berlin oder im Umkreis und kannst zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt starten. Wir sind eine der am schnellstwachsenden Digitalagenturen Hamburgs und suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt neue Mitarbeiter/innen mit Schwerpunkt Wirtschaftsinformatik für den Bereich Business-Development!

Was macht die Cordes Consulting GmbH genau?

Wir sind eine Werbeagentur, welche Handwerksunternehmen durch innovative Social-Media-Strategien dabei hilft, mehr Bewerbungen von Fachkräften aus der Region zu erhalten. Wir vermarkten also mittelständische Unternehmen als attraktive Arbeitgeber in den sozialen Netzwerken.

Als Wirtschaftsinformatiker/-in - Vollzeit (m/w/d) systematisierst du Prozessabläufe, setzt eigenverantwortlich Projekte um und implementierst neue Prozesse in unserem Unternehmen. Gemeinsam mit uns arbeitetest du an der Zukunft von Cordes Consulting und treibst unser Unternehmenswachstum voran. 


Aufgabengebiete:

  • Geschäftsprozesse etablieren: Damit wir weiter wachsen können, benötigen wir exzellente Geschäftsprozesse und Abläufe. Als Wirtschaftsinformatiker/-in - Vollzeit (m/w/d) führst du diese in unserem Unternehmen ein und legst damit die Weichen für unser Wachstum.

  • Prozessverbesserung: Als Wirtschaftsinformatiker/-in - Vollzeit (m/w/d) musst du alle unserer Geschäftsprozesse verstehen und überblicken. Dabei erkennst du Verbesserungspotenziale und optimierst unsere internen Abläufe.

  • Projekte begleiten: Du begleitest die Einführung von neuen IT-Systemen und leitest interne Projekte, welche unser Unternehmen voranbringen.

  • Schulungen: Wenn du neue Prozesse etabliert, verstanden und verbessert hast, bist du für die Protokollierung und Aufnahmen von Schulungsmaterialien für unsere interne Schulungsplattform zuständig. 


Wenn du weitere Informationen zu unserem Unternehmen und deiner Karriere bei Cordes Consulting haben möchtest, findest du diese auf www.cordes-karriere.de.


Grundgehalt: Wirtschaftsinformatiker/-in - Vollzeit (m/w/d): 5.500 € brutto im Monat

Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten sind vorhanden.

Die Einarbeitungsphase dauert in der Regel 2–4 Monate.

Das erwartet Dich bei uns: 

  • Eine gute Vergütung über dem Branchendurchschnitt.

  • Ausführliche interne Schulung: Durch unser internes Schulungssystem lernst du alles, was du für deine neue Tätigkeit bei uns im Unternehmen benötigst.

  • Hervorragende Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Über die nächsten Jahre werden wir weiter stark wachsen.

  • Einen tollen Firmenstandort in Hamburg Rotherbaum am Mittelweg mit Dachterrasse und moderner Ausstattung.

  • Eine tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Uns ist ein positives Umfeld wichtig. Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang.

  • Ein dynamisches Team ein motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld.

  • Einen sichereren Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine unbefristete Übernahme.

  • Eine erstklassige Büroausstattung: Wir arbeiten ausschließlich mit moderner Technik und Arbeitsausstattung.

  • Wir übernehmen die Kosten für dein Deutschlandticket oder einen Tiefgaragenstellplatz in unserem Bürogebäude.

  • Cordes Consulting Gesundheitssystem: Profitiere von umfangreichen Gesundheitsleistungen für dich und deine Familienangehörigen (u. a. 900 € jährliches Gesundheitsbudget für Privatleistungen, Facharzt-Terminvereinbarung innerhalb von 5-10 Tagen, ärztliche Zweitmeinung sowie ein 24/7 Gesundheitstelefon)


  • Erfolgreiches Bachelor oder Master Studium im Bereich BWL, Business Administration, Business Management, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Bankwesen oder Ähnliches

  • Analytisch-methodisches und strukturiertes Denken, Organisationsfähigkeit, Ergebnis- und Lösungsorientierung sowie ausgeprägte Teamorientierung gepaart mit sicherem Auftreten, einer selbstständigen Arbeitsweise und einem hohen Maß an Kommunikationsfähigkeit.

  • Sehr strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Erfahrung in der Anwendung von Projektmanagement

  • Die Fähigkeit, bestehenden Prozessen zu folgen, diese zu verstehen und zu verbessern

  • Sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten.

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und hohe Disziplin.

  • Starke kommunikative Fähigkeiten und ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Präzision.

  • Guter Umgang mit Leistungsdruck.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Telnyx</strong></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a </span></em><a href="https://telnyx.com/our-network"><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">private, global, multi-cloud IP network</span></em></a><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">, to bringing </span></em><a href="https://telnyx.com/resources/about-edge-connectivity"><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">hyperlocal edge</span></em></a><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"> technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.</span></em></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.</span></em></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.</span></em></p></div><p data-start="3512" data-end="3596">&nbsp;</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <div id="message-list_1789158556.563599"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div><strong>The Role</strong><br><br>We're building a local Enterprise Sales Pod in Munich — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in your market. You'll embed directly with enterprise customers to architect and ship production systems on Telnyx's global network — voice, messaging, AI, and wireless.<br><br>This isn't about demoing products. It's about building real solutions that work at scale.<br><br>You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated Enterprise AE — not a demo resource, but a commercial partner who owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, and closes the deal. You own the technical side: discovery, architecture, POC, and production go-live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall.<br><br><em>The Pod Model</em><br><br><em>Enterprise AE</em> — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account. .<br><br><em>Forward Deployed Engineer</em> — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.<br><br>We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.<br><br><strong>What You'll Do</strong><br><br>• Embed with enterprise customers to understand their communications workflows, AI use cases, and integration challenges firsthand<br>• Build and deploy custom implementations: AI Voice Assistants, Telnyx APIs (Voice, Messaging, Fax, Wireless), WebRTC<br>• Run open-weight LLMs in customer environments — consume GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, and MiniMax through Telnyx Inference (OpenAI-compatible API; there's no model infrastructure for you to run), or deploy self-hosted stacks (Llama, Mistral, and region-specific models like Aleph Alpha's Luminous, or sovereign EU models) behind your own serving engine when air-gapped or sovereign-cloud requirements demand it<br>• Deploy and operate LiteLLM as the model gateway in customer environments: a unified OpenAI-compatible interface across self-hosted open-weight models and hosted providers, with routing, load balancing, retries and fallbacks, rate limits, and per-team virtual keys<br>• Instrument and govern LLM usage through the gateway — cost tracking and budgets, caching, logging and observability (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar), and guardrails — so customers can see and control what their AI workloads are doing<br>• Wire production observability for everything you ship — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting (e.g. Prometheus + Grafana for metrics, OpenTelemetry for traces, Graylog or ELK for logs — or the customer's existing stack) — so you and the customer's ops team both know what "healthy" looks like and what pages whom when it isn't<br>• Design model routing strategies for real-time voice workloads, balancing latency, cost, and quality, with sane fallback behavior when a provider degrades<br>• Make the build-vs-buy case between self-hosted open-weight models and hosted frontier APIs, and keep the customer's application code portable across both<br>• Adapt models to customer domains: prompt and RAG pipelines and evaluation harnesses for German-language use cases and DACH-specific regulatory environments (GDPR, EU AI Act, German data localization)<br>• Lead POCs, pilots, and production launches from whiteboard to go-live<br>• Own customer outcomes — stay engaged until the solution is live and stable<br>• Collaborate directly with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap based on field insights from Germany, Austria, and Switzerland<br>• Create clear technical documentation, runbooks, and maintainable solutions for handoff</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div id="message-list_1789158556.594389"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div>• Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues alongside customer teams<br><br><strong>What We're Looking For</strong><br><br>• CS degree or equivalent experience<br>• 3+ years building and shipping production software — you've written code that real users depended on, you've been on-call for it, and you've debugged it when things broke. (A consulting background counts if this is also true of you.)<br>• Proficiency in multiple languages: Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go — you're more dangerous in some than others. (Telnyx Edge Compute — functions and stateful actors — is TypeScript, so that one pulls double duty.)<br>• Practical understanding of what breaks in front of a model in production: provider rate limits and quotas, timeout and retry behavior, streaming, token accounting and cost attribution, and the failure modes that only show up under concurrency<br>• Comfortable deploying containerized services on Kubernetes, with secrets management, config, and upgrades as part of the deployment story<br>• You've wired observability and been paged because of it — Prometheus + Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Graylog, ELK, or equivalent. You know what to monitor, what to alert on, and what "healthy" looks like<br>• High-concurrency experience — Kafka, message queues, or event streams at real scale. When throughput spikes you know what breaks — consumer lag, backpressure, hot partitions, rebalance stalls — and what absorbs it: partitioning, consumer groups, parallelism up to your partition count<br>• You've built APIs from scratch, not just consumed them — OpenAPI spec, REST/GraphQL design, auth, rate limiting, versioning, idempotency<br>• Event-driven thinking and cloud-native instincts<br>• Exposure to SIP, WebRTC, or real-time voice/messaging systems<br>• Self-sufficient by default — there's no engineering team behind you. You read the code and the docs, ask the customer (not your manager), and make sound engineering judgment calls on your own<br>• Customer-facing engineering experience — you can run discovery with a customer's engineers and present to their executives in the same week<br>• Ability to translate "it's not working" into root cause<br>• Comfortable working on customer sites and in high-stakes technical conversations<br>• Excellent written and verbal communication in English and German. You can run whiteboard sessions, live troubleshooting, and escalations with customer engineering teams.<br>• Based in Munich, or willing to relocate — this is a hybrid role with travel across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland<br>• Legally authorized to work in Germany, or eligible for sponsorship<br><br><em>Bonus Points For</em><br><br>• Experience with AI voice assistants, STT/TTS, or LLM-based conversational systems<br>• Building eval sets for a specific domain<br>• Hands-on production experience with an LLM gateway — LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway, or an in-house OpenAI-compatible proxy — including config-driven model definitions, routing and fallback rules, and virtual key management<br>• Familiarity with the open-weight model landscape and the trade-offs between regional and multilingual models, including EU sovereign AI initiatives (Gaia-X, Aleph Alpha, European LLM projects)<br>• Experience with an inference serving engine behind the gateway — vLLM, SGLang, or TGI for production serving; Ollama for lightweight on-prem — and sizing GPU capacity for self-hosted models (KV-cache footprint, concurrent batch size, and context length against VRAM)<br>• SQL proficiency (Postgres, MySQL, Oracle)<br>• ETL and data wrangling experience<br>• CI/CD pipeline design and automation<br>• Background in telecom, CPaaS, or high-growth SaaS<br>• Experience with sovereign or on-prem cloud deployments and DACH regulatory frameworks (GDPR, EU AI Act, German data sovereignty and localization requirements, Swiss data protection)<br>• Security mindset (IAM, encryption, audit logging)</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <p><em>#LI-RH1</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <p><strong>AI Content Creator - Content Creation</strong></p> <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior AI Content Creator in the HelloFresh Studio, you are part of the AI Content Creation team and play a leading role in developing and scaling AI-powered content creation across mainly photography, but also supporting video, design, and emerging creative formats.</p> <p>You combine a strong background in commercial visual production with hands-on expertise in generative AI. You have a refined visual eye and strong creative judgment, allowing you to create high-quality content yourself and recognize what makes an image or video successful. Beyond creating individual assets, a key part of your role is translating creative direction and successful approaches into reliable, production-ready workflows that expand the Studio's AI capabilities. Working closely with art directors, photographers, retouchers, video, design, and tech, you identify where AI can improve creative possibilities, production efficiency, and scale. You help define best practices, evaluate emerging technologies, and continuously develop how AI is used in visual production across the Studio.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Create high-quality AI-powered content across commercial photography and video, including lifestyle, food, product, and campaign content, translating creative direction into assets ready for real production and marketing use.</li> <li>Develop and refine AI content creation workflows, prompts, techniques, and reusable approaches using tools such as Krea, Higgsfield, Claude, ComfyUI, and emerging platforms.</li> <li>Work closely with Art Directors, Photographers, Video, Design, and Post-Production to translate creative concepts and established visual approaches into scalable AI-powered production workflows.</li> <li>Use your creative judgment and production experience to continuously improve visual quality, realism, consistency, and efficiency across AI-generated content.</li> <li>Partner with Workflow Specialists to identify automation opportunities and help turn successful creative processes into scalable or automated content-generation workflows.</li> <li>Evaluate emerging AI models, tools, and techniques, testing their practical value and introducing those that meaningfully improve creative output or production.</li> <li>Define and share best practices, standards, and documentation for AI content creation, and support colleagues in developing their AI capabilities.</li> <li>Stay closely connected to developments in generative AI, actively experimenting with new approaches and identifying opportunities to expand what the Studio can create.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>5+ years of professional experience in commercial photography, retouching, art direction, or a closely related visual production discipline</strong>, with a strong understanding of professional photography and/or video production.</li> <li>Advanced hands-on experience creating high-quality visual content with generative AI tools and integrating AI into real creative or production workflows.</li> <li><strong>A refined visual eye and strong creative judgment</strong>, with an excellent understanding of photography, composition, lighting, colour, visual storytelling, realism, and what makes commercial imagery feel premium and intentional.</li> <li>Proven ability to interpret creative briefs and translate creative direction into high-quality visual content and repeatable production approaches.</li> <li>Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across creative, production, and technical teams.</li> <li>You are proactive, curious, and solution-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership, an experimental mindset, and genuine enthusiasm for emerging AI technologies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Please include a portfolio of your recent and relevant work.</strong></p> <p><br><br></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

diversity:</strong> We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be heard</li> <li><strong>Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together:</strong> We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact</li> <li><strong>Grow</strong>: We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure</li> <li><strong>Customer at the heart</strong>: We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems</li> <li><strong>Candour with caring:</strong> We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we can offer you</strong></p> <ul> <li>A workplace pension, through Royal London, with Fospha matching your contributions up to 3%</li> <li>A £1,000/year flexible benefits allowance to put towards private medical insurance, dental cover, a health cash plan, gym membership, extra holiday, or a pension top-up - whatever suits you!</li> <li>Access to Wellhub, giving you one membership across gyms, boutique studios, and wellbeing apps</li> <li>25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays, an extra day off for your birthday! and more holiday the longer you stay (26 days after 3 years, 27 after 6)</li> <li>Life assurance worth 4x your annual salary, from day one</li> <li>Cycle to Work scheme, plus discounts on everyday spending through our benefits portal — Apple, Tesco, IKEA, M&amp;S, Deliveroo, cinema tickets and more</li> <li>Quarterly one-to-one sessions with a financial adviser, plus access to payroll-deducted loans through Salary Finance</li> <li>Paid volunteering days each year</li> <li>Regular socials, free weekly snacks, and Lunch &amp; Learn events at our Scale Space office, plus access to the wider Blenheim Chalcot community</li> <li>Opportunities to travel — including to our India and North America offices</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Process</strong></p> <ul> <li>15-minute screening call with a member of the Talent Team</li> <li>30-minute Hiring Manager interview</li> <li>Task and Panel interview</li> <li>Final Exec interview</li> </ul> <p><em>Top tip: Make sure to thoroughly research Fospha and tell us why you would be a great fit for the role!</em></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information, please visit&nbsp;<a href="http://www.vml.com/" data-outlook-id="d4b7d1c3-8ad6-4b6d-ab45-d3cb5a3aebe1">www.vml.com </a>and follow along on <a href="https://urldefense.proofpoint.com/v2/url?u=https-3A__urldefense.com_v3_-5F-5Fhttps-3A_www.linkedin.com_company_vml_-5F-5F-3B-21-21JboVxjCXSME-21OhlpCfbkl1UcWPwns1-2DGtvHOzFh0QwHV49fsPgGw-2DVCCU1bCg8aQFI9vN-2Dy-2DVwaQcITH2j2XKzGKBIFRLYf2AUWVYY1dFGK6-24&amp;d=DwMFaQ&amp;c=euGZstcaTDllvimEN8b7jXrwqOf-v5A_CdpgnVfiiMM&amp;r=zouFnm4jZMgDFaYF1uVcRY3rbgHWPca_luUrBUkT6Yc&amp;m=QzcCgXCAOjzj5hiU48_CKOdHRSJ4_YpuqfviT9yjlzH5VrkzySTZ-WaQXlYAnj4W&amp;s=jJ7q5V70u9oUx7ONPm5jC3IK8y6vxDilX6BGTlqlWlA&amp;e=" data-outlook-id="a3ef68bf-16fb-4ebc-9ca9-406007d6cefc">LinkedIn</a>&nbsp;#WeAreVML.</p></div><p></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We are seeking an experienced Optimisation Principal to lead experimentation-led growth (ELG) initiatives for our key global clients. In this role, you will define and execute data-driven growth strategies, champion a culture of continuous testing and learning, and integrate modern tech stacks to deliver measurable ROI and long-term business impact.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Be Doing</strong></p> <p><strong>1. Strategy &amp; Innovation</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Drive Growth Strategy:</strong> Define and deploy scalable Experimentation-Led Growth (ELG) frameworks, methodologies, and best practices tailored to client business objectives.</li> <li><strong>Cultivate Testing Culture:</strong> Champion an evidence-driven mindset across client organisations, shifting teams from basic A/B testing to sophisticated, hypothesis-led experimentation.</li> <li><strong>Insights to Action:</strong> Lead cross-functional teams in designing, executing, and analysing experiments, translating complex data into strategic growth initiatives.</li> </ul> <p><strong>2. Global Client &amp; Stakeholder Partnership</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Ownership:</strong> Act as the principal advisor for all global optimisation activities, building trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders across diverse regions.</li> <li><strong>Performance Storytelling:</strong> Deliver strategic forecasting, executive-level performance reporting, and actionable recommendations tied to core business KPIs.</li> </ul> <p><strong>3. Program &amp; Commercial Management</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>End-to-End Delivery:</strong> Oversee global program operations, managing resources, timelines, and budgets to ensure on-schedule, in-scope execution.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Rigour:</strong> Maximise resource allocation, monitor program throughput, and rigorously measure ROI to justify financial investment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>4. Technical Solution Architecture</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Tech Stack Integration:</strong> Architect integrated technical solutions, ensuring seamless interoperability across experimentation platforms, analytics suites, CMSs, CDPs, and personalisation engines.</li> <li><strong>Infrastructure Guidance:</strong> Oversee technical planning and delivery to ensure underlying data pipelines and tools effectively support client growth targets.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Visionary Leadership:</strong> Extensive experience leading global growth/optimisation strategies, driving organisational change, and managing multi-region client portfolios.</li> <li><strong>Deep Technical Stack Expertise:</strong> Hands-on mastery and architectural understanding of:</li> <li><strong>Experimentation:</strong> Adobe Target, Optimizely (client/server-side, statistical rigor).</li> <li><strong>Analytics:</strong> GA4, Adobe Analytics, Amplitude (segmentation, event tracking).</li> <li><strong>CDP &amp; Personalisation:</strong> Segment, Tealium, Dynamic Yield, Braze (data unification, activation, real-time engines).</li> <li><strong>CMS &amp; Data Infra:</strong> AEM, Sitecore, data warehousing, governance, and pipelines.</li> <li><strong>Data &amp; Statistical Rigour:</strong> Advanced proficiency in statistical analysis for A/B testing, data synthesis, and translating metrics into business strategy.</li> <li><strong>Flawless Program Execution:</strong> Demonstrated ability in Agile/Waterfall delivery, resource planning, risk management, and budget oversight for complex, global accounts.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Strong influencer capable of uniting product, engineering, marketing, and data science teams around shared growth goals.</li> </ul> <p></p> <h3>What we can offer you:</h3> <p>Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.</p> <p><strong>Permanent only:</strong><br>We offer a great benefits package including a discretionary bonus scheme, training opportunities, competitive pension, medical insurance, life assurance, social events, opportunities to buy and sell holidays, family friendly policies, discounts with hundreds of retailers and much more.</p> <p>Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.</p> <p>We lead with&nbsp;<strong>Heart</strong>, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.<br>We empower your&nbsp;<strong>Brains&nbsp;</strong>for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.<br>And we champion&nbsp;<strong>Courage</strong>, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.</p> <h2><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">At&nbsp; WPP</span><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2"> Enterprise Solutions</span></span></h2> <p><span data-contrast="auto">WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernisation, connecting strategy directly to execution.&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX, work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. </span><span data-contrast="none">We have received distinction as a leader in Commerce Services and CX Strategy Consulting by the Forrester Wave™&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">To find out more</span><span data-contrast="auto">, visit </span><a href="https://enterprisesolutions.wpp.com/"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">enterprisesolutions.wpp.com</span></span></a><span data-contrast="auto"> and follow us on </span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/wpp-enterprise-solutions"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">LinkedIn</span></span></a><span data-contrast="auto">.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions is part of <a href="https://urldefense.com/v3/__http:/wpp.com/__;!!IfJP2Nwhk5Z0yJ43lA!L_cfT4E3gsmmDY1lVQTB6ihlfPeBl9X4sMM2KI6iWZYexC2nCeZ9oxgP9qvgbrqxIBpx82rGb_mWqh5F0zKxq5_dP7Y$" target="_blank">WPP</a>, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. raw.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Data Platform
raw.description:
About Evervault

Evervault offers modular payments infrastructure for companies building their own payments stack. We keep raw card data off your systems, cut PCI compliance work, improve acceptance, mitigate fraud and chargebacks and decrease your cost of payments, so you keep full control. Trusted by Ramp, Rippling, Modern Treasury and Overwolf; Series B, led by Ribbit Capital.

Role Overview

You’ll be the first engineer dedicated to our data platform, and you’ll design and build it largely from scratch. You’ll own the platform that collects our event data, models it, and serves it to customers with roughly 15-second freshness, including building our time-series foundations. This is a senior, hands-on role: you’ll set the architecture, write most of the code and set the bar for the data team that grows around you. You’ll work closely with our VP of Engineering, Product and our leadership team. Product decides which data products to build; you own how they’re built and what the data can support.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Designing and building real-time ingestion for three sources: events our platform already emits, new instrumentation in our product, and data our customers send us

  • Rebuilding our event streaming layer, with the authority to choose how

  • Modelling structured and time-series data in ClickHouse and Databricks so aggregations, trends and benchmarks are fast and cheap at scale (our current defaults, though you can make the case for change)

  • Designing the external data contracts and APIs customers build on, including versioning, reliability and isolation of each customer’s data

  • Defining the event contracts our product engineers instrument against

  • Owning the platform in production: monitoring, data quality, cost and on-call for the systems you build

Your First Year

In your first few months you’ll assess what we have, decide the platform architecture, and scope our first data product with Product and Engineering. After that, you’ll rebuild the streaming layer and ship the first external product on the new platform, most likely aggregated analytics or direct data access for customers. Later in the year you’ll help us hire a domain expert who decides which signals and benchmarks are worth building. Machine learning is out of scope for now; it comes once we have enough clean historical data.

Requirements

  • Production experience building real-time or near-real-time ingestion with event streaming, such as Kafka, Kinesis or Redpanda

  • Deep experience with ClickHouse or a similar analytical database, including modelling time-series data for fast aggregation at volume

  • A track record of shipping an external, multi-tenant data product or data API that customers depended on (internal reporting pipelines alone won’t cover this)

  • Experience migrating a messy live system to a new one without downtime or data loss

  • Senior-level engineering habits: system design, testing, and running the services you build in production

  • Sound judgement working independently: you’ll be our most senior data voice, and we’ll rely on your technical calls

  • A product mindset: you won’t work directly with customers, but you’ll often be the person who knows what the data can and can’t support

Nice to Have

  • Experience in payments or with sensitive, regulated data

  • Databricks or Spark experience alongside ClickHouse

  • Experience as an early or founding member of a data team, including hiring

This Might Not Be for You If…

  • You’re mainly an analyst, BI or data science specialist: this role builds the platform and the external products on it

  • Your experience is mostly dashboards, internal reporting pipelines or modelling for analysis

  • You want a hands-off architect role: you’ll write most of the code

  • You want to work fully remotely: we’re in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday

Compensation, Benefits & Why Join

  • Competitive salary

  • Stock options with an extended exercise window

  • Private health insurance

  • Unlimited PTO & flexible working hours

  • Daily lunch budget

  • Build a company’s data platform from the first line of code, with the authority to make the big architectural calls and work directly with C-Level

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Hiring Manager Interview

  3. Technical Interview

  4. System Design Interview

  5. Final with our Founder

  6. References and Offer

Location

This role is based in London, in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday. We do not currently sponsor UK work visas.

Candidates must be based in the location specified. Any applications from candidates not in the required location may not receive a response.

title: Principal, Woven Capital
description: Woven Capital is Toyota's growth-stage venture capital arm focused on advancing the future of mobility – how people, goods, information and energy move. We manage $1.6 billion, investing in companies that create new ways to support mobility and emerging technologies, advance the industrial value chain, and accelerate decarbonization and sustainability. Our work connects breakthrough innovators with Toyota's global platform, strengthening the company's capabilities today while creating new opportunities for tomorrow. WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? Woven Capital is seeking an experienced Partner / Principal in London to shape the EMEA investment strategy, deepen founder and co-investor relationships, and formalize the foundation for Woven Capital’s presence in EMEA. Reporting to the CIO, the successful candidate will not only be able to lead investments end-to-end, but will also be ready and comfortable to conduct due diligence, develop trust relationships with business units on collaboration projects, and train and mentor other members of the team to develop their personal growth and career paths. RESPONSIBILITIES Source and develop investment opportunities by building and leveraging referral networks and relationships to generate high-quality deal flow. Cultivate and manage relationships with entrepreneurs, investors, academics, and industry leaders in Woven Capital’s areas of focus. Lead investment due diligence by conducting market and industry research and engaging with company management, industry participants, competitors, customers, and other relevant stakeholders to assess investment opportunities. Develop financial models and investment analyses, including valuations, optimal capital structures, investment terms, potential returns, and exit scenarios. Structure and negotiate transactions, including drafting and reviewing term sheets, expressions of interest, and letters of intent, and negotiating deal terms and transaction documents with prospective portfolio companies, co-investors, and other relevant parties. Develop investment recommendations by preparing and presenting investment memo to the Woven Capital Investment Committee for review and approval. Drive portfolio value creation by actively monitoring investments, participating in board meetings as a director or observer, advising portfolio companies on strategy and growth, and facilitating strategic partnerships and business opportunities between portfolio companies and Toyota Group companies. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 10+ years of investment experience in venture capital, corporate venture capital, or private equity, with a strong track record of sourcing, evaluating, executing, and managing investments. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, with a strong analytical foundation. A degree in finance, business, economics, engineering, science, or another relevant discipline is preferred. A natural collaborator and self-starter who takes ownership, demonstrates strong leadership, and consistently drives initiatives to successful outcomes. Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, build alignment across diverse interests, and navigate complex organizational dynamics to achieve results. Ability to build trusted relationships across Toyota and its broader ecosystem, and translate those relationships into strategic opportunities and tangible business outcomes for portfolio companies. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex ideas and tailor messages and presentations to different audiences. Track record of hiring, developing, and mentoring talent, as well as leading teams and managing multiple priorities in parallel. Ability to navigate cultural, linguistic, and organizational differences, and move initiatives forward across global teams with different decision-making processes. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS MBA, JD, or advanced graduate degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Math or other quantitative discipline highly desired. Japanese language ability is a plus but not required. Experience working, studying, or living in different cultures and geographies is a plus but not required. Our Commitment ・We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. ・Any information we receive from you will be used only in the hiring and onboarding process. About the Role: 

We are looking for a strategic and results-driven Senior Partner Account Executive to launch, scale, and optimise partnerships across our ecosystem with a focus on insurance carriers and brokers. Samsara's telematics and dashcam technology already help thousands of customers improve safety and reduce risk - this role will accelerate those benefits by developing high-impact partnerships that drive mutual growth.

You will be the face of Samsara to insurance executives, building scalable programmes that directly influence customer acquisition, retention, and loss cost improvement. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, are motivated by measurable business impact, and enjoy turning ideas into reality, this is your opportunity to make a difference.

Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

In this role you will:

  • Own and grow our relationships with insurance carriers, brokers and MGAs in the UK
  • Design and run partner programmes that drive customer acquisition, retention and loss-cost improvement - and the Samsara revenue that comes with them
  • Map accounts with partners, pick joint targets and bring Samsara sales into the deals
  • Build the playbook: how we qualify, onboard and scale insurance partnerships

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact - helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your partners are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live. Samsara's top employees do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.

Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

  • Exceptional relationship management skills, with experience engaging stakeholders from the C-suite to front-line sales teams.

  • Experience working in or with insurance carriers, brokers, or related financial services.
  • Consulting experience, ideally working with insurance companies.

  • Make an impact: Your work will directly improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability in industries that power the global economy.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
The Select Major Accounts team is Samsara's primary engine for enterprise growth, responsible for landing high-value, net-new logos across the UK & Ireland's largest physical operations. In this role, you will lead multi-million-dollar, full-cycle sales processes from a cold start—executing a disciplined qualification playbook, building true C-suite champions, and closing strategic $1M+ ARR deals. This position is built for an elite, strategic Account Executive who thrives in complex, multi-stakeholder environments—equally comfortable navigating IT and lines of business to digitize industries traditionally reliant on legacy systems.

Why Now? Samsara combines the agility of a high-growth startup, the market authority of a public company, and the momentum of a hyper-scale tech leader. Named a Best Place to Work for 3 consecutive years, we offer enterprise sellers a combination of unique differentiators:

  • Proven Leadership & Hyper-Growth: Founded by serial entrepreneurs with a history of building multi-billion-dollar companies, Samsara has scaled past $2.1B+ ARR with 30%+ YoY global growth.

  • Market-Dominating Platform: Backed by $2.8B+ in R&D investment, our Connected Operations Cloud makes us the Category Leader delivering class-leading AI, IoT, and telematics capabilities with a genuine AI moat.

  • Massive Untapped Market: Physical operations represent a $160B+ Global TAM, with EMEA remaining 99% greenfield opportunity.

This brings strong upside earning potential on a winning trajectory, rapid professional growth alongside elite sales talent, and a massive, unpenetrated territory waiting to be captured.

Whilst we do support remote working, flexibility is required to travel to visit customers onsite across the region as required.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 


In this role, you will:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts 
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Mobilize a large matrix virtual team of business stakeholders to include Operations, Finance, IT, dedicated Solution Engineer and Account Development Representative
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Min. 7+ years full-cycle Enterprise-level Account Executive closing expertise, winning complex SAAS deals
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $1M+ ARR deal execution
  • New Logo & Self-generated pipeline: Demonstrated ability to build and win deals through a repeatable outbound prospecting motion
  • Structured Qualification: Mastery of Playbook methodology-led selling (e.g. MEDDPICC / Command of the Message / Force Management) to quantify genuine business pain
  • Champion & Economic Buyer navigation: Proven ability to test and build true champions, access executive buying centres, and engineer compelling events
  • A Team player used to winning as a team, collaborative and within a coachable growth mindset

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Awards for elite achievement (particularly President's Club, Winner's circle, Top 10%)
  • Passionate about transformational technology in the world operations 
  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

raw.title: Select Major Account Executive, UK&I
raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
The Select Major Accounts team is Samsara's primary engine for enterprise growth, responsible for landing high-value, net-new logos across the UK & Ireland's largest physical operations. In this role, you will lead multi-million-dollar, full-cycle sales processes from a cold start—executing a disciplined qualification playbook, building true C-suite champions, and closing strategic $1M+ ARR deals. This position is built for an elite, strategic Account Executive who thrives in complex, multi-stakeholder environments—equally comfortable navigating IT and lines of business to digitize industries traditionally reliant on legacy systems.

Why Now? Samsara combines the agility of a high-growth startup, the market authority of a public company, and the momentum of a hyper-scale tech leader. Named a Best Place to Work for 3 consecutive years, we offer enterprise sellers a combination of unique differentiators:

  • Proven Leadership & Hyper-Growth: Founded by serial entrepreneurs with a history of building multi-billion-dollar companies, Samsara has scaled past $2.1B+ ARR with 30%+ YoY global growth.

  • Market-Dominating Platform: Backed by $2.8B+ in R&D investment, our Connected Operations Cloud makes us the Category Leader delivering class-leading AI, IoT, and telematics capabilities with a genuine AI moat.

  • Massive Untapped Market: Physical operations represent a $160B+ Global TAM, with EMEA remaining 99% greenfield opportunity.

This brings strong upside earning potential on a winning trajectory, rapid professional growth alongside elite sales talent, and a massive, unpenetrated territory waiting to be captured.

Whilst we do support remote working, flexibility is required to travel to visit customers onsite across the region as required.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 


In this role, you will:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts 
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Mobilize a large matrix virtual team of business stakeholders to include Operations, Finance, IT, dedicated Solution Engineer and Account Development Representative
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Min. 7+ years full-cycle Enterprise-level Account Executive closing expertise, winning complex SAAS deals
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $1M+ ARR deal execution
  • New Logo & Self-generated pipeline: Demonstrated ability to build and win deals through a repeatable outbound prospecting motion
  • Structured Qualification: Mastery of Playbook methodology-led selling (e.g. MEDDPICC / Command of the Message / Force Management) to quantify genuine business pain
  • Champion & Economic Buyer navigation: Proven ability to test and build true champions, access executive buying centres, and engineer compelling events
  • A Team player used to winning as a team, collaborative and within a coachable growth mindset

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Awards for elite achievement (particularly President's Club, Winner's circle, Top 10%)
  • Passionate about transformational technology in the world operations 
  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

raw.title: Select Major Account Executive, UK&I
raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
The Select Major Accounts team is Samsara's primary engine for enterprise growth, responsible for landing high-value, net-new logos across the UK & Ireland's largest physical operations. In this role, you will lead multi-million-dollar, full-cycle sales processes from a cold start—executing a disciplined qualification playbook, building true C-suite champions, and closing strategic $1M+ ARR deals. This position is built for an elite, strategic Account Executive who thrives in complex, multi-stakeholder environments—equally comfortable navigating IT and lines of business to digitize industries traditionally reliant on legacy systems.

Why Now? Samsara combines the agility of a high-growth startup, the market authority of a public company, and the momentum of a hyper-scale tech leader. Named a Best Place to Work for 3 consecutive years, we offer enterprise sellers a combination of unique differentiators:

  • Proven Leadership & Hyper-Growth: Founded by serial entrepreneurs with a history of building multi-billion-dollar companies, Samsara has scaled past $2.1B+ ARR with 30%+ YoY global growth.

  • Market-Dominating Platform: Backed by $2.8B+ in R&D investment, our Connected Operations Cloud makes us the Category Leader delivering class-leading AI, IoT, and telematics capabilities with a genuine AI moat.

  • Massive Untapped Market: Physical operations represent a $160B+ Global TAM, with EMEA remaining 99% greenfield opportunity.

This brings strong upside earning potential on a winning trajectory, rapid professional growth alongside elite sales talent, and a massive, unpenetrated territory waiting to be captured.

Whilst we do support remote working, flexibility is required to travel to visit customers onsite across the region as required.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 


In this role, you will:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts 
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Mobilize a large matrix virtual team of business stakeholders to include Operations, Finance, IT, dedicated Solution Engineer and Account Development Representative
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Min. 7+ years full-cycle Enterprise-level Account Executive closing expertise, winning complex SAAS deals
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $1M+ ARR deal execution
  • New Logo & Self-generated pipeline: Demonstrated ability to build and win deals through a repeatable outbound prospecting motion
  • Structured Qualification: Mastery of Playbook methodology-led selling (e.g. MEDDPICC / Command of the Message / Force Management) to quantify genuine business pain
  • Champion & Economic Buyer navigation: Proven ability to test and build true champions, access executive buying centres, and engineer compelling events
  • A Team player used to winning as a team, collaborative and within a coachable growth mindset

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Awards for elite achievement (particularly President's Club, Winner's circle, Top 10%)
  • Passionate about transformational technology in the world operations 
  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.
